cohort: 178 neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 infected mothers at a tertiary care center in rural Telangana, India
finding: Neonatal outcomes were generally good, with only one neonate testing positive for SARS-CoV-2 and all neonates being discharged after two negative RT-PCR tests.
mod_finding: Most neonates (80.5%) were delivered by Cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in 18.9% of neonates
